text: 据路透，中美正加紧筹备9月中旬举行的会谈，探讨AI安全风险。消息人士透露，美方希望讨论如何合作监测AI驱动的网络攻击。有倡议要求中美AI实验室“自我监管”并共享信息，以防止与AI有关的网络攻击。 此次会谈是自美国总统特朗普去年重返白宫以来，中美首次就AI问题举行正式双边会谈。听取相关筹备简报的知情人士说，美方代表团将由美国财政部长贝森特率领。中方代表团可能由国务院副总理何立峰率领。不过，中方也在考虑其他人选，包括副总理丁薛祥。报道称，美国财政部发言人表示，目前尚未规划任何会议。
text_en: According to Reuters, China and the U.S. are intensifying preparations for talks in mid-September to discuss AI security risks. Sources said Washington hopes to discuss how to cooperate on monitoring AI-driven cyberattacks. There are initiatives calling for 'self-regulation' and information sharing between Chinese and American AI labs to prevent AI-related cyberattacks. The talks would mark the first formal bilateral meeting between China and the U.S. on AI since President Trump returned to the White House last year. Sources briefed on the preparations said the U.S. delegation would be led by Treasury Secretary Bessent, while the Chinese delegation may be led by Vice Premier He Lifeng, though other candidates including Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang are also being considered. A U.S. Treasury spokesperson said no meeting has been planned at this time.
